Xuanzang's Places

Every country and site of the Da Tang Xiyu ji (大唐西域記), with Mizutani Shinjō's identification (1971), the views of Julien, Vivien de Saint-Martin, Cunningham, Majumdar, Beal, Watters and Dey, the field reports of the Archaeological Survey (1862–87), Mukherji's Tarai survey (1901) and the Survey's Annual Reports (1903–37), and what the British Indian district gazetteers add. Colour shows how settled Mizutani says a place is; a dark ring marks a place where the gazetteer evidence changes his picture.

Dashed line: countries visited, in the order of the narrative. Points are approximate.
